purpose: Prevent MathBridge from mixing different PEP mathematics textbook generations when mapping Chinese classroom sequence.

current_series.name_cn: 人教版第十二套义务教育教材·小学数学
current_series.basis: 义务教育数学课程标准（2022年版）
current_series.confirmed_launch: 2024秋季起始年级正式投入使用

critical_rules: Never merge unit sequences from the older PEP edition and the 12th-series edition into a single grade map without an edition field.
Every textbook-derived curriculum mapping must store edition, volume, unit, and verification status.
A curriculum standard can support stage expectations, but exact grade/semester placement should come from the textbook or teacher guide actually used.
Where a school uses a non-PEP textbook, MathBridge must preserve the national curriculum mapping and swap only the textbook-sequence layer.

verified_new_series_features.statement_cn: 每册按单元组织知识群，单元内一般按知识序列分小节和知识点，整册末安排“复习与关联”。
verified_new_series_features.teacher_significance_en: The new series is explicitly structured around connected units and ends each volume with a review-and-connections unit, so MathBridge should model unit-level and cross-unit relationships rather than isolated standards.

verified_new_series_features.statement_cn: 一年级上册“5以内数的认识和加、减法”与“6～10的认识和加、减法”调整为两个连续单元。
原先分开的“万以内的加减法（一）”和“万以内的加减法（二）”在新教材中适当整合。
“两位数乘两位数”与“三位数乘两位数”在新教材体系中整合。
新教材以“计数单位”为贯穿整数、小数、分数认识和运算的重要主线。
verified_new_series_features.teacher_significance_en: This is a major pedagogical bridge point: Chinese textbook design explicitly links whole numbers, decimals and fractions through counting units, not merely through separate procedures.

legacy_series_policy.reason: Older PEP resources remain useful for historical sequencing, teacher-practice evidence and transition comparison, but they must not be presented as the current 12th-series sequence by default.
